name: GDP Growth
description: Real GDP growth (base 2022-23) measures the year-on-year expansion of India's economy at constant prices. The latest reading compares April-June 2026 with April-June 2025.
source: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI), National Accounts
releaseSchedule: Released quarterly, about two months after quarter-end. Q2 FY27 (July-September) is due on 30 November 2026.

chart.title: Growth picked up from a year earlier

chart.source: MoSPI press note on GDP estimates for Q1 2026-27, 31 Aug 2026
